brief: GS FICC & Equities weekly thematic note. Equities stay tied to energy/rates vol, but secular AI baskets rallied this week (AI +7.7%, HALO +6.0%, Megacap vs Non-Profitable Tech +3.9%). Next week: French budget bill Thursday, US NFP Friday, Brazil's first-round election Sunday. Five points. First, agentic AI adoption in consumer shopping is a 3-5+ year transition like eCommerce, shifting the question to who owns discovery/intent/infra; the Agentic vs Consumer Inertia trade continues (Inertia -12% since launch) and a growing cyber-fraud TAM is lifting the Cybersecurity basket (+130% off YTD lows). Second, GS says it's time to short Non-Profitable Tech: 10Y yields have risen 7 straight months, and NPT's normal rate-sensitivity, which broke down over the past year, is now reasserting (-11.8% this month, falling retail participation). Third, DOE's $5.25bn grid-investment plan (20+GW) revives the Power trade into a year-end catch-up, with Europe power/renewables also benefiting. Fourth, GS is bullish German fiscal beneficiaries (spend above expectations, low debt/GDP) but bearish French domestics (debt/GDP toward 125% by 2030, wide OAT-Bund spread), expressed via a December put spread, with near-term relief possible on the Le Pen narrative. Fifth, ahead of Brazil's Oct 4 vote, GS likes the Brazil rate-sensitive basket for a re-rating if a Bolsonaro win prices in rate cuts.
